summary: PDS Biotechnology Corp filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, LTD. The company will issue a $6 million promissory note and a warrant for up to 2,158,274 shares at $1.1824 per share. Closing is expected around June 12, 2026, subject to customary conditions including Nasdaq listing. The agreement includes debt incurrence and lien covenants. This structured financing (debt plus equity warrant) is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Watch for dilution risk from warrant exercise and note repayment terms.
